name: DMCreative Recoverly for WooCommerce
author: dmcreative

sections.description:
DMCreative Recoverly for WooCommerce helps WooCommerce store owners follow up with shoppers who leave products in the cart before completing checkout.

The Lite version includes a practical free recovery workflow:

  • Track active WooCommerce carts.
  • Capture guest checkout email, name, and phone when available.
  • Mark carts as abandoned after a configurable delay.
  • Send one automatic reminder email.
  • Restore the saved cart through a secure recovery link.
  • Notify the store administrator when a cart becomes abandoned.
  • View abandoned, recovered, ordered, ignored, and active carts in the WordPress admin.
  • Export cart records to CSV.

No license server, tracking pixel, external service, or third-party library is used in this Lite version. The plugin includes a non-intrusive Upgrade page with feature comparison links that are opened only when an administrator clicks them.

Upgrade to Pro

DMCreative Recoverly Pro for WooCommerce is available separately for stores that need more advanced recovery automation. Pro/Lifetime options include:

  • Three-step email automation.
  • Coupon recovery.
  • Advanced rules and exclusions.
  • Suppression lists.
  • Monthly reports and performance analytics.
  • Priority support.

The Lite plugin remains fully usable without upgrading and does not contact any license server.

Trademark notice

WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WooCommerce or Automattic.

Privacy

This plugin stores cart data, customer email, name, phone, IP address, user agent, and recovery activity in custom database tables on the same WordPress installation. Data is used only for abandoned cart recovery and administrator notifications. No data is sent to external services by this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to Abandoned Carts > Settings.
  5. Configure the abandoned cart delay, email template, sender, and admin notification recipients.
  6. Test with a guest/incognito checkout session.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does the Lite version use a license server?

No. The Lite version is free and does not use remote license activation.

How many reminder emails are included?

The Lite version sends one reminder email.

Does the recovery link restore the cart?

Yes. If the original products are still available, the recovery link restores the saved cart and redirects the shopper to cart or checkout.

Does the plugin send data to external services?

No. The Lite version stores data locally in your WordPress database and uses WordPress/WooCommerce email delivery.

Can I export abandoned carts?

Yes. The dashboard includes a CSV export option.
